```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================================
# Regional comparison (fast):
# alpha + PCoA(first) + PERMANOVA(199) + betadisper
#
# R Markdown version
# - Original script style retained
# - Reads exported QIIME2 feature-table.tsv directly
# - Alpha diversity plot changed to violin plot
# - Saves PDF and SVG figures
#
# CAVEAT:
# 3 distant regions => differences are expected and CONFOUNDED, not sharing.
# =====================================================================

required_pkgs <- c("vegan", "svglite")

for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(pkg)
  }
}

suppressMessages(library(vegan))
```

# 1. User parameters

```{r parameters}
## ------------------------- USER PARAMETERS ---------------------------
asv_table_path <- "inputs/exported_clustering_table/feature-table.tsv"
metadata_path  <- "inputs/clustering_meta.txt"

sample_id_col  <- NA
region_col     <- "category"

table_features_as_rows <- TRUE

do_rarefy      <- TRUE
min_depth      <- NA

detect_thr     <- 0.001

permutations   <- 199
pcoa_max_n     <- 2000

seed           <- 1
out_dir        <- "results"
## --------------------------------------------------------------------

set.seed(seed)
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

tic <- function(msg) {
  cat(sprintf("[%s] %s\n", format(Sys.time(), "%H:%M:%S"), msg))
}
```

# 2. Helper functions

```{r helper-functions}
read_tsv_table <- function(path, far = TRUE) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Feature table not found: ", path)
  }

  first <- readLines(path, n = 1)

  skip <- if (grepl("^# Constructed", first)) 1L else 0L

  df <- read.table(
    path,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    skip = skip,
    row.names = 1,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  m <- as.matrix(df)
  storage.mode(m) <- "numeric"

  if (!far) {
    m <- t(m)
  }

  m
}

read_metadata <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    stop("Metadata file not found: ", path)
  }

  lines <- readLines(path)

  lines <- lines[!grepl("^#q2:types", lines)]

  con <- textConnection(lines)
  on.exit(close(con))

  read.table(
    con,
    header = TRUE,
    sep = "\t",
    quote = "",
    comment.char = "",
    check.names = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

format_p <- function(p) {
  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("NA")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("<0.001")
  }

  sprintf("%.3g", p)
}

violin_at <- function(v, xc, width, col) {
  v <- v[is.finite(v)]

  if (length(v) < 5) {
    return(invisible())
  }

  d <- density(v)
  w <- d$y / max(d$y) * width

  polygon(
    c(xc - w, rev(xc + w)),
    c(d$x, rev(d$x)),
    col = col,
    border = "grey30",
    lwd = 0.7
  )

  qs <- quantile(v, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE)

  rect(
    xc - 0.045,
    qs[1],
    xc + 0.045,
    qs[3],
    col = "white",
    border = "grey30",
    lwd = 0.7
  )

  segments(
    xc - 0.065,
    qs[2],
    xc + 0.065,
    qs[2],
    lwd = 1.3
  )
}
```

# 3. Load table and metadata

```{r load-data}
tic("loading table + metadata")

feat <- read_tsv_table(
  asv_table_path,
  far = table_features_as_rows
)

meta <- read_metadata(metadata_path)

dim(feat)
head(meta)
```

# 4. Match sample IDs

```{r match-samples}
if (is.na(sample_id_col)) {
  cand <- c(
    "sample_id",
    "sample-id",
    "sampleid",
    "SampleID",
    "#SampleID",
    "id",
    "ID",
    "#OTU ID",
    "featureid"
  )

  hit <- cand[cand %in% colnames(meta)]

  if (!length(hit)) {
    stop(paste(
      "set sample_id_col. cols:",
      paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
    ))
  }

  sample_id_col <- hit[1]

  message("Using sample-id column: ", sample_id_col)
}

if (!(region_col %in% colnames(meta))) {
  stop(paste(
    "region_col not found. cols:",
    paste(colnames(meta), collapse = ", ")
  ))
}

meta <- data.frame(
  sample_id = trimws(as.character(meta[[sample_id_col]])),
  region = trimws(as.character(meta[[region_col]])),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

colnames(feat) <- trimws(colnames(feat))

common <- intersect(colnames(feat), meta$sample_id)

if (!length(common)) {
  stop("no overlapping sample ids")
}

cat(sprintf(
  "Samples table=%d metadata=%d overlap=%d\n",
  ncol(feat),
  nrow(meta),
  length(common)
))

feat <- feat[, common, drop = FALSE]
meta <- meta[match(common, meta$sample_id), ]

counts <- t(feat)
counts <- counts[rowSums(counts) > 0, , drop = FALSE]

meta <- meta[match(rownames(counts), meta$sample_id), ]

dim(counts)
head(meta)
```

# 5. Rarefaction

```{r rarefaction}
if (do_rarefy) {
  depth <- rowSums(counts)

  target <- if (is.na(min_depth)) {
    min(depth)
  } else {
    as.integer(min_depth)
  }

  low <- depth < target

  if (any(low)) {
    counts <- counts[!low, , drop = FALSE]
    meta <- meta[match(rownames(counts), meta$sample_id), ]
  }

  counts <- rrarefy(counts, sample = target)

  tic(sprintf("rarefied to %d", target))
}

region <- factor(meta$region)

cat("Samples per region:\n")
print(table(region))

relab <- sweep(counts, 1, rowSums(counts), "/")
pa <- (relab >= detect_thr) * 1L

pa <- pa[, colSums(pa) > 0, drop = FALSE]
```

# 6. Alpha diversity

```{r alpha-diversity}
tic("alpha diversity")

shannon <- diversity(counts, index = "shannon")

kw <- kruskal.test(shannon ~ region)

pw <- suppressWarnings(
  pairwise.wilcox.test(
    shannon,
    region,
    p.adjust.method = "BH"
  )
)

alpha_df <- data.frame(
  sample_id = rownames(counts),
  region = as.character(region),
  shannon = shannon,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  alpha_df,
  file.path(out_dir, "region_alpha.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

kw
pw$p.value
```

# 7. Alpha diversity violin plot

```{r alpha-violin-plot, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
region_levels <- levels(region)

alpha_cols <- setNames(
  c("#cfe8f3", "#f4a6a6", "#c7e9c0", "#d9d2e9", "#fdd0a2", "#b2dfdb")[seq_along(region_levels)],
  region_levels
)

alpha_ymax <- max(shannon, na.rm = TRUE)
alpha_ymin <- min(shannon, na.rm = TRUE)
alpha_rng <- alpha_ymax - alpha_ymin

draw_alpha_violin <- function() {
  par(mar = c(4, 4, 4, 1))

  plot(
    NA,
    xlim = c(0.5, length(region_levels) + 0.5),
    ylim = c(alpha_ymin - alpha_rng * 0.05, alpha_ymax + alpha_rng * 0.18),
    xaxt = "n",
    xlab = "",
    ylab = "Shannon diversity",
    main = sprintf("Alpha (KW p=%s)", format_p(kw$p.value))
  )

  axis(
    1,
    at = seq_along(region_levels),
    labels = region_levels
  )

  for (k in seq_along(region_levels)) {
    v <- shannon[region == region_levels[k]]

    violin_at(
      v = v,
      xc = k,
      width = 0.30,
      col = alpha_cols[region_levels[k]]
    )
  }

  box()
}

# PDF 저장
pdf(
  file.path(out_dir, "region_alpha.pdf"),
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)
draw_alpha_violin()
dev.off()

# SVG 저장
svglite::svglite(
  file.path(out_dir, "region_alpha.svg"),
  width = 5,
  height = 5
)
draw_alpha_violin()
dev.off()

# R Markdown 화면 출력
draw_alpha_violin()
```

# 8. Distances and PCoA

```{r distances-pcoa}
tic("computing distances")

d_bray <- vegdist(counts, method = "bray")
d_jac <- vegdist(pa, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)

plot_pcoa <- function(d, region, label, fname_base) {
  dm <- as.matrix(d)
  n <- nrow(dm)

  if (!is.na(pcoa_max_n) && n > pcoa_max_n) {
    idx <- sort(sample(seq_len(n), pcoa_max_n))
    dm <- dm[idx, idx]
    rg <- droplevels(region[idx])
  } else {
    rg <- region
  }

  cm <- cmdscale(as.dist(dm), k = 2, eig = TRUE)

  ev <- cm$eig
  pv <- 100 * ev / sum(ev[ev > 0])

  cols <- setNames(
    c("#1f77b4", "#ff7f0e", "#2ca02c", "#d62728")[seq_along(levels(rg))],
    levels(rg)
  )

  draw_pcoa <- function() {
    plot(
      cm$points,
      col = cols[as.character(rg)],
      pch = 19,
      cex = 0.5,
      xlab = sprintf("PCo1 (%.1f%%)", pv[1]),
      ylab = sprintf("PCo2 (%.1f%%)", pv[2]),
      main = label
    )

    legend(
      "topright",
      legend = levels(rg),
      col = cols,
      pch = 19,
      bty = "n"
    )
  }

  # PDF 저장
  pdf(
    paste0(fname_base, ".pdf"),
    width = 5.5,
    height = 5
  )
  draw_pcoa()
  dev.off()

  # SVG 저장
  svglite::svglite(
    paste0(fname_base, ".svg"),
    width = 5.5,
    height = 5
  )
  draw_pcoa()
  dev.off()

  # R Markdown 화면 출력
  draw_pcoa()
}

tic("PCoA Bray")

plot_pcoa(
  d_bray,
  region,
  "PCoA Bray-Curtis",
  file.path(out_dir, "region_pcoa_bray")
)

tic("PCoA Jaccard")

plot_pcoa(
  d_jac,
  region,
  "PCoA Jaccard",
  file.path(out_dir, "region_pcoa_jaccard")
)

tic("PCoA done -> figures ready")
```

# 9. PERMANOVA and betadisper

```{r permanova-betadisper}
run_pn <- function(d, label) {
  tic(paste("PERMANOVA", label))

  a <- adonis2(d ~ region, permutations = permutations)

  bd <- betadisper(d, region)
  pt <- permutest(bd, permutations = permutations)

  list(
    R2 = a$R2[1],
    F = a$F[1],
    p = a$`Pr(>F)`[1],
    disp_p = pt$tab$`Pr(>F)`[1]
  )
}

res_bray <- run_pn(d_bray, "Bray-Curtis")
res_jac <- run_pn(d_jac, "Jaccard")

res_bray
res_jac
```

# 10. Pairwise PERMANOVA

```{r pairwise-permanova}
pw_pn <- function(d) {
  lev <- levels(region)
  cmb <- combn(lev, 2)
  dm <- as.matrix(d)

  out <- data.frame()

  for (k in seq_len(ncol(cmb))) {
    gpair <- cmb[, k]
    sel <- region %in% gpair

    a <- adonis2(
      as.dist(dm[sel, sel]) ~ droplevels(region[sel]),
      permutations = permutations
    )

    out <- rbind(
      out,
      data.frame(
        pair = paste(gpair, collapse = " vs "),
        R2 = a$R2[1],
        F = a$F[1],
        p = a$`Pr(>F)`[1]
      )
    )
  }

  out$p_adj <- p.adjust(out$p, "BH")

  out
}

tic("pairwise PERMANOVA")

pwb <- pw_pn(d_bray)
pwj <- pw_pn(d_jac)

pwb
pwj
```

# 11. Save statistics

```{r save-statistics}
region_permanova <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    metric = "Bray",
    test = "global",
    group = "all",
    R2 = res_bray$R2,
    F = res_bray$F,
    p = res_bray$p,
    p_adj = NA
  ),
  data.frame(
    metric = "Jaccard",
    test = "global",
    group = "all",
    R2 = res_jac$R2,
    F = res_jac$F,
    p = res_jac$p,
    p_adj = NA
  ),
  data.frame(
    metric = "Bray",
    test = "pairwise",
    group = pwb$pair,
    R2 = pwb$R2,
    F = pwb$F,
    p = pwb$p,
    p_adj = pwb$p_adj
  ),
  data.frame(
    metric = "Jaccard",
    test = "pairwise",
    group = pwj$pair,
    R2 = pwj$R2,
    F = pwj$F,
    p = pwj$p,
    p_adj = pwj$p_adj
  )
)

region_dispersion <- data.frame(
  metric = c("Bray", "Jaccard"),
  betadisper_p = c(res_bray$disp_p, res_jac$disp_p)
)

write.csv(
  region_permanova,
  file.path(out_dir, "region_permanova.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

write.csv(
  region_dispersion,
  file.path(out_dir, "region_dispersion.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

region_permanova
region_dispersion
```
